Reference / url/query

url/query#

The query of a URL as parameters, read like json.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let query = ParsedQuery("q=tea&page=2&tag=a&tag=b").parameters();
query.text("q");                         // "tea"
query.maybe("page").int() else 1;        // 2
query.list("tag");                       // ["a", "b"]
query.boolean("all");                    // MissingQueryParameter when absent

Description#

The query of a URL as parameters, read like json.

A parameter written without = is present but unassigned.

object ParsedQuery#

object ParsedQuery

The parameters of a query string, decoded as RFC 3986 query text (not HTML form text: "+" stays "+").

let page = ParsedUrl("https://example.com/search?q=okkama&page=2").parts();
let query = ParsedQuery(page::Parts::query else "").parameters();
query.text("q");                      // "okkama"
query.int("page");                    // 2
query.maybe("limit").int() else 20;   // 20
query.list("tag");                    // [] when absent

With a name given more than once, text(), int() and boolean() read the first value and list() all of them. Parameters are built part by part: QueryParameters(QueryParameter(name: "q", value: "okkama")).string().
